cornerstone.holders: All cornerstone investors (Harvest Oriental, Hengtong Optic-electric International, Dream’ee HK Fund, Deep Source, Haitian Huayuan, New Fortune, Qianhai Hezhong Investment)
cornerstone.full_quote: Each Cornerstone Investor has agreed that it will not, and will cause its affiliates not to, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investors, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; restricted period inclusive of Listing Date
cornerstone.notes: Undertaking also binds affiliates ('will cause its affiliates not to').

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) in the period commencing on the date of the prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares of the Company in respect of which he/she/it is shown in the prospectus to be the beneficial owner (the “Relevant Securities”)
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1): period commencing on the date of the prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the 'First Six-month Period'); computed as six calendar months from Listing Date
controller_6m.notes: Commencement is stated as 'the date of the prospectus' (end anchor remains six months from Listing Date).

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the period referred to in paragraph (a) above expires, dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests, or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares referred to in paragraph (a) above if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he/she/it would cease to be a controlling shareholder of our Company (as defined in the Listing Rules)
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): period of six months commencing on expiry of the (a) period, i.e. ends 12 months from Listing Date; disposal restricted if the shareholder would cease to be a controlling shareholder
